name: Grade 6 T2 Practice: August Week 3 - Demo Reflection
description: Practice words for testing, explaining, and reflecting on the final robotics challenge.

words.definition: A task that takes effort to complete.
words.example: The challenge was to reach the finish marker.

words.definition: To try something and see if it works.
words.example: We test the program before showing it.

words.definition: To find and fix a problem in a program.
words.example: We debug when the robot turns the wrong way.
We improve the route after testing.

words.definition: The people who see or hear your work.
words.example: The audience watched the robot demo.

words.definition: To make an idea clear with words.
words.example: Students explain what their robot does.

words.definition: Thinking about what worked and what to improve.
words.example: The reflection described one debugging step.
